# is_free_lock is safe outside of reserved connection
"select is_free_lock('foo') from dual"
{
  "PlanID": "Select",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select is_free_lock('foo') from dual limit :#maxLimit"
}

# is_used_lock is safe outside of reserved connection
"select is_used_lock('foo') from dual"
{
  "PlanID": "Select",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select is_used_lock('foo') from dual limit :#maxLimit"
}

# release_all_locks mutates connection-scoped lock state: on a reserved
# connection a timeout must kill the connection rather than keep it with lock
# state the session never recorded. It does not require reserving, though —
# vtgate sends it as a plain execute when the session holds no locks, and a
# pooled connection can hold no user-level lock, so releasing there is a safe
# no-op
"select release_all_locks() from dual"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectLockFunc",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select release_all_locks() from dual limit :#maxLimit"
}

# release_lock kills the connection on timeout like get_lock, but does not
# require a reserved connection
"select release_lock('foo') from dual"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectLockFunc",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select release_lock('foo') from dual limit :#maxLimit"
}

# impossible lock query is safe outside of reserved connection
"select get_lock('foo', 10) from dual where 1 != 1"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectImpossible",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select get_lock('foo', 10) from dual where 1 != 1 limit :#maxLimit"
}

# get_lock cannot be executed outside of reserved connection
"select get_lock('foo', 10) from dual"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectLockFunc",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select get_lock('foo', 10) from dual limit :#maxLimit",
  "NeedsReservedConn": true
}

# a mutating lock function counts anywhere in the statement, not just in the
# select list: a predicate-placed get_lock would otherwise acquire a lock on a
# pooled connection and leak it to the connection's next borrower
"select id from t where get_lock('foo', 10) = 1"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectLockFunc",
  "TableName": "",
  "Permissions": [
    {
      "TableName": "t",
      "Role": 0
    }
  ],
  "FullQuery": "select id from t where get_lock('foo', 10) = 1 limit :#maxLimit",
  "NeedsReservedConn": true
}

# a predicate-placed release function classifies too (timeout kills the
# connection) but stays runnable on a pooled connection
"select id from t where release_lock('foo') = 1"
{
  "PlanID": "SelectLockFunc",
  "TableName": "",
  "Permissions": [
    {
      "TableName": "t",
      "Role": 0
    }
  ],
  "FullQuery": "select id from t where release_lock('foo') = 1 limit :#maxLimit"
}

# the pure reads stay ordinary selects wherever they appear
"select 1 from dual where is_free_lock('foo') = 1"
{
  "PlanID": "Select",
  "TableName": "",
  "FullQuery": "select 1 from dual where is_free_lock('foo') = 1 limit :#maxLimit"
}
